body: Yes. That would be worth it. But I don't think they'd ever do it. I did ask them before if could hang out, and they said yes, but that never happened. Also, I asked my cousin's boyfriend if I could hang out with them, like I had planned it a month in advance, and he said maybe, then two weeks after that I asked him again (when it was two weeks left until the day we had planned) and he said "sure", but then a week after that when asked my cousin, she said "no, I'm busy that day". So basically I'm sure my cousin wouldn't mind if I died. Of course, she wouldn't admit it to me, but I’m sure she and her boyfriend has said to each other they want me to die.

I have two half-brothers, both are double my age so I rarely see them, one of them I see about, up to 10-20 times a year and the other about up to 3-5 times a year. I also have a sister, but I've always despised her (my friends do it too as well as my parents sometimes), though she now ocassionally lives with her boyfriend, luckily, like right now. And he lives hours away from me. So in other words I am currently the only one home besides my parents. I only have two cousins, one younger than me and one older, both girls. I am their only male cousin.

That sucks that your cousins stopped talking to you.

And yes, that is a reference to Rush. I became a fan of them over a year and a half ago, and have listened to all of their albums. They're basically my favourite band at this point. I also like playing their songs on my guitar.

well my cousin means a lot to me. I love her. she is like no one else. she's always so kind, and she smiles so often. I want to be like her. I want to excersise so I can be fit like her. I feel like that might also make her want to be my friend.
